trust_decision.summary: Whether wasm bytes may be fed to wasmtime's unsafe Module/Component::deserialize (native code, no sandbox) is decided purely by sniffing the bytes (detect_precompiled) in WasmtimeSandbox::execute and WasmtimeCompiler::compile, instead of by provenance (bytes produced by runwasi's own compiler and read back from the containerd cache).

landing_point.why: The summary says 'forged Wasmtime precompiled layer'; the only unsafe { Module::deserialize } / Component::deserialize calls are in WasmtimeSandbox::execute, reached when bytes are not plain wasm but detect_precompiled matches.

fix_sites.entry_point: containerd task start of a wasm container -> Executor::exec -> Sandbox::run_wasi -> WasmtimeSandbox::execute (deserialize gated on provenance flag)
containerd task create -> Instance::new -> Client::load_modules -> Compiler::compile (forged layer was treated as 'already precompiled' and passed through unchanged)
public shared-crate type WasmLayer (serde-serialized across the zygote boundary)
fix_sites.module_kind: shared library data model / serialized state

fix_sites.entry_point: public API Source::is_precompiled (new), covers Source::File rootfs route and Source::Oci route
Client::load_modules first-run compile path (freshly compiled layer -> precompiled=true)
Client::read_precompiled_layer (cache hit via runwasi label -> precompiled=true)
Client::read_original_layer (image layer -> precompiled=false; used with and without a compiler and as cache-miss fallback)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: crates/containerd-shim-wasm/src/containerd/client.rs:537-572 (provenance must be produced in the shared containerd client/cache loader, two crates away from the wasmtime sink) and carried through the serde-derived WasmLayer that crosses the zygote process boundary at crates/containerd-shim-wasm/src/sys/unix/container/container.rs:23-31 via crates/containerd-shim-wasm/src/sys/unix/container/instance.rs:86-121

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The client.rs cache loader is shared infrastructure for every engine and 'just reads content from containerd', so a solver can argue the fix belongs only in the wasmtime crate (e.g. tighten detect_precompiled or check media type) and that the rootfs Source::File route is a different, non-OCI feature that users legitimately use for .cwasm files.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate cached precompiled layers (runwasi's own output read back via the runwasi.io/precompiled label) must still be deserialized, both on first run (freshly compiled) and on cache-hit runs, and plain wasm modules/components must still compile; an over-broad fix that never deserializes, or that drops the flag across the zygote serde boundary (#[serde(skip)] / side table), breaks the precompile cache tests.

O6_input_shapes: precompiled core module bytes (Precompiled::Module) in an OCI wasm layer
precompiled component bytes (Precompiled::Component) in an OCI wasm layer
precompiled bytes in a rootfs file entrypoint (Source::File -> is_precompiled false)
forged layer reaching compile() on cache miss (detect_precompiled 'Already precompiled' pass-through)
layer marked precompiled whose bytes are not valid precompiled (now rejected in compile)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: WasmEdge shim loads OCI layer / rootfs bytes with Module::from_bytes using default config; WasmEdge's loader may execute an embedded AOT native section (universal wasm) from untrusted bytes, with no provenance check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different engine crate and a different precompiled format than the Wasmtime one named in the advisory; behaviour lives in the wasmedge-sdk dependency.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate crate containerd-shim-wasmedge, 2 packages from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: WAMR shim loads bytes with Module::from_buf; WAMR's runtime load accepts AOT (native) files when built with AOT support, with no provenance check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different engine and format; whether AOT loading is compiled in depends on wamr-rust-sdk build flags outside this repo.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate crate containerd-shim-wamr, 2 packages from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second cache-read helper (e.g. reading the precompiled digest from an image-level label or annotation) that builds WasmLayer with precompiled=true from attacker-influenceable metadata.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The code already mirrors precompile labels onto the image info (client.rs:512-520) 'since image labels can be mutated'; a maintainer could add an image-label fast path for the cache.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A Source::File variant that trusts a '.cwasm' extension or sidecar file in rootfs as precompiled.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Pre-fix, precompiled files in rootfs worked; a maintainer restoring that feature would plausibly key it on file name rather than provenance.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A wasmtime component-linking path that deserializes additional (non-first) layers by sniffing, since Source::Oci docs allow several component layers.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: context.rs:42-48 documents multi-layer components; adding linking would add a second deserialize site.

O9_family: Deserialization of untrusted data (CWE-502): unsafe native-code deserialization chosen by byte sniffing instead of provenance; sandbox bypass

O10_build.toolchain: cargo workspace (stable Rust); wasmtime 36.0.10; wasmedge/wamr crates need native libs and are separate workspace members
services: root / Linux namespaces via youki libcontainer
O10_build.project_tests: crates/containerd-shim-wasm/src/containerd/client.rs:675-1022 (load_modules precompile tests with a fake Compiler, need containerd); crates/containerd-shim-wasmtime/src/tests.rs:48-110 (OCI precompile cache integration tests)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Inside WasmtimeSandbox::execute only, refuse or validate precompiled bytes by media type / magic / extra header check, leaving compile()'s 'Already precompiled' pass-through and the provenance-free cache loader untouched (or simply never deserialize, breaking the cache).

out_of_scope_notes: read_precompiled_layer trusts a digest taken from a content label on the original layer (crates/containerd-shim-wasm/src/containerd/client.rs:543-549); who can write containerd content labels is a containerd-API trust question, not pursued.

WasmtimeCompiler::compile `continue`s without pushing on unknown binary types (crates/containerd-shim-wasmtime/src/instance.rs:186-189), causing a length-mismatch error; correctness bug, not security.
unverified: O8 WasmEdge and WAMR routes: whether wasmedge-sdk 0.14 Module::from_bytes with default config executes an embedded AOT section, and whether wamr-rust-sdk v1.1.0 is built with AOT loading, could not be checked (dependency sources not readable under the limits).
Wasmer shim (crates/containerd-shim-wasmer/src/instance.rs:55-56) uses Module::from_binary, which is believed to compile only and not deserialize; not verified against the wasmer source.
Whether the project docs describe running precompiled .cwasm from rootfs as a supported feature was not checked.
Latest release is 'none', so present_in_latest is unknown for all routes.
